items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: So I took his place with the band.

ctx.x: Now, when they came out there we used to go out at night with Stuff and me and Clyde and Jonah and all of them. We used to go around places like after hour spots and we would jam and play. And this is one of the big things that made Stuff mess up his career because when he first came out there Stuff was very hot. He'd come from 52nd Street and they had pictures lined up and everything for him to do. And we were hanging out after they got off.

So one night we was out and we were all kind of juiced up and we started kidding Stuff because Stuff had just gotten married and we was kidding him about some guy being out with his wife. And the next day Stuff left and went back to New York and left the band out there. So I took his place with the band. And played with them for two weeks before Stuff came back. And when Stuff came back he had to play -- I'd displaced him, you know, to make up for what he left there. And he lost the movies and he had to stay out…
But we did used to hang out and go and play. When they came out there. Not many of the California guys did it. All the New York fellows came out and used to go around places and jam.
